# Five Year Vision

> [!vision] Five Year Vision Details
>

> [!question] Prompt
>
> Write in the present tense as if it is five years in the future.
>
> Where do I want to be and how do I want to feel in five years?

## Personal

- Growth
	- How do you want to grow and evolve as a person?
		- I want to be the person other people can rely on, both for getting things done and for support.
		- I want to be the person that I can rely on.
	- What are the personal qualities, traits, or values that you want to develop or enhance?
		- I want to be resilient in the face of hardship.
		- I want to continue learning.
		- I want to be passionate.
	- What are the personal passions, hobbies, or interests that you want to explore or pursue?
- Mental Health
	- How do you want to feel and think?
		- I want to feel confident in my abilities and knowledge.
		- I want to feel vulnerable, yet formidable.
		- I want to be open to new ideas and flexible about old opinions.
	- What are the sources of joy, peace, or satisfaction that you want to experience more of?
		- I want to experience more happiness and satisfaction.
		- I want give and feel more love from my friends and family.
	- What are the coping strategies, practices, or resources that you want to use or access to improve your mental well-being and happiness?
		- I want to continue with my journaling habit.
		- I want to continue searching for and implementing new interventions for my mental health.
- Physical Health
	- How do you want to look and perform?
		- I want to be able to play with children for an hour at a time and not get tired.
		- I want to keep a limber body.
	- What are the health goals or outcomes that you want to achieve or maintain?
		- I want build my core strength to support my day-to-day life.
	- What are the lifestyle changes or habits that you want to adopt or sustain to enhance your physical health and fitness?
		- I want to implement twenty minutes of daily movement.
- Education
	- How do you want to learn and grow?
		- I want to solidify my learning foundations.
		- I want to build off of my foundations to remain relevant in an ever-changing world.
	- What are the new skills, knowledge, or abilities that you want to learn or master?
		- I want to master math until multivariate calculus.
	- What are the educational or academic goals or opportunities that you want to pursue or complete?
	- What are the benefits or rewards that you expect from advancing your education or career?
- Financial
	- How do you want to manage and use your money?
		- I want to be able to put aside 1000 shekels a month.
	- What are the financial goals or milestones that you want to achieve or maintain?
		- I want Sam and me to be able to set aside 100,000 NIS for a child one day.
		- I want Sam and me to set aside enough money to buy an apartment.
	- What are the financial habits or behaviors that you want to change or adopt to improve your financial security and freedom?
		- I want Sam and me to spend intentionally.
		- I want Sam and me to save money whenever possible.

## Interpersonal

- Marriage
	- How do you want to relate and connect with your spouse?
		- I want to always work on how we care for each other.
		- I want to be an anchor of support for Sam in her times of need and for her to be my anchor in my times of need.
	- What are the expectations, values, or principles that you and your spouse share or want to establish for your marriage?
		- Mutual respect
		- Love
		- Kindness
		- Consideration
	- What are the ways that you want to communicate, support, and respect each other?
- Family
	- How do you want to interact and bond with your parents and siblings?
		- I want to continue strengthening the bond with Gene
		- I want to strengthen the bond with my sisters.
	- How do you want to interact and bond with your nieces and nephews in the next five years?
		- I want to have a place in their lives as a person with whom they can have fun and turn to for support.
	- What are the activities or events that you want to do or have with your family?
		- I want to do activities that create memories.
	- What are the memories or stories that you want to preserve or create with your family?
- Friends
	- How do you want to socialize and have fun with your friends?
		- Regularly in order that we remain in each others' lives as a source of love and happiness.
	- Who are the friends that you want to keep or make in your life?
	- What are the qualities or characteristics that you look for or appreciate in your friends?

## Professional

- Career
	- How do you want to work and succeed?
		- I want to always be trying to learn and innovate.
		- I want to work with singular focus and stop with as much focus to create a work-life balance.
	- What are the career aspirations, opportunities, or challenges that you want to pursue or face?
		- I want to become a valuable employee in my field.
	- What are the skills, talents, or achievements that you want to showcase or improve in your field?
		- I want to showcase the power of continual learning.
